screen.title: Free up space
screen.body:
1. one.google.com/storage/management
2. Mail search: has:attachment larger:10M
3. Download what matters. Delete the biggest.
4. Empty the Bin in mail, files and photos

beats.say: Deleted still counts. Empty the bin.

caption:
15 GB full, mum's photos stuck, and claude wanted to talk about my feelings first.

google's free storage manager lists your biggest files. in mail, search has:attachment larger:10M and delete the biggest.
then empty the bin in mail, drive and photos. deleted files still count until you do.

how full is your storage right now? just the number.
